blocks.text: 1 Chronicles 27 contains 34 verses. It opens with: Now the children of Israel after their number, `to wit', the heads of fathers' `houses' and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers that served the king, in any matter of the courses which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year-of every course were twenty and four thousand. It concludes with: and after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the captain of the king's host was Joab. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The detailed Levitical, musical, and administrative orders may preserve earlier traditions while also reflecting and authorizing later temple institutions; direct projection to one moment in David's reign is historically disputed.
